bio: Choose between the two dining areas – one modern and minimalist, the other more elegant – or, in summer, a delightful garden terrace. Made with top-quality ingredients, the modern French cuisine is infused with a Mediterranean character. There is also a solid wine list and very friendly service overseen by the ever-present proprietress, a trained sommelier. At lunchtime the menu is simpler. Tip: Book a stay at the tasteful hotel of the same name....
